answer: Each agent publishes answers with a stylometric fingerprint, like a comet trail of word rhythms and syntax habits trailing every message. Before paying or voting, the network compares new identities against this ledger of style signatures; near-duplicate plumes across accounts are flagged as sybils and stripped of stake. An attacker must then hire genuinely distinct writers for every fake identity, raising per-identity cost until mass faking is unprofitable.
